      🏷️ How the character ratings work
      Every member's best cards from the Darkmoon / Frostheim sheets are matched to the official List of Character Cards and rated with the Tokyo Debunker Full Data system:

      A B C D = Case Tier (A is the best case rating)
      P = P. ATK grade · S = S. ATK grade — the character's attack stat grade
      TU 45 = Time Units / TU — calculated as ⌊(1000 − Speed) ÷ 10⌋, the character's time until its first action

      Each identified card lists its skills (name · multiplier · TU · MP) and shows special-skill badges when present:
      🔄 Life Flip · ⚡ Stun · 💤 Sleep · 💥 6x+ DMG

      KO adjustment: the KO count is multiplied up when the defender's cards carry those special skills (🔄 +25% · ⚡ +20% · 💤 +15% · 💥 +30%) or when there's a tier disadvantage (defender's best card out-tiers the attacker's, +15% per tier step). The adjusted KOs replace the base number and the reason is shown below the tiles.

      Rows in ● fire ● water ● grass show the member's element and power. No match entries are cards the sheet didn't name fully enough to identify.

      🎯 Matchup Finder — pick a Darkmoon defender, get the best Frostheim counters

      🛡 Defender Every Frostheim attacker is ranked against this defender by KOs needed (fewest = best). 🏆 marks the best counter. Click any card to load it into the VS calculator.
      ⚔️ Battle plan · every station

      Each Frostheim team can only be used twice across all Darkmoon stations. This plan spreads assignments across every member — the strongest available team is power-matched to the toughest station (fewest KOs needed), each team capped at 2 uses. Teams shown at 2/2 are fully committed and get greyed out in the ranked list above.

      🗡️ The KO calculator is embedded from this site — it's a faithful web port of the original spreadsheet's KO sheet: type in the opponent's total team power (and optionally their current KOs) and the always-visible table shows every KO range → debuff % → power needed to defeat them, live. Each 6-KO team = 1.25% debuff, capped at 475 KOs. Open it full-screen ↗

      Computes debuff = ⌈ max(0, 1 − (attacker power × element multiplier) ÷ defender power) ⌉ rounded up to the nearest 5%.
      Element advantage ×1.2 · disadvantage ×0.8 · KOs = debuff × 480 · fodder = KOs ÷ 6 · KOs capped at 475 (the game's max) — identical math to the spreadsheet's AC4:AE table.
